profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Capital One
profile.summary: Experienced Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in an agile environment. Skilled in Java, test automation and DevOps. Strong engineering professional with a Master's degree focused in Computer Science from North Carolina State University.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Modernizing and securing bank transaction authorization systems using the latest technologies and processes.
positions.insights: Skills: Go (Programming Language) · REST APIs · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · NoSQL · FinTech

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Fixed critical bugs and developed time sensitive enhancements based on customer’s requests and functional requirements.
•	Migrated applications libraries and frameworks to the latest version to avoid vulnerabilities.
•	Managed release deployments of applications to staging and production environments. 
•	Added additional pipelines to increase efficiency of application deployments and to perform security stack update when needed.
•	Wrote integration and mock/unit tests in an effort to achieve 100% code coverage across the HSES code base.
•	Participated in the business development proposal process by reviewing and providing input on Request for Information and Request for Proposal responses. 
•	Contributed to the development of the company’s corporate capability deck by providing detailed input on capabilities related to Cloud infrastructure and management.
•	Reviewed pull request and provided feedback for improvements to team members prior to approval and merger of code.
•	Developed full stack proof of concept enterprise application using Spring Boot microservices and Next.js.
positions.insights: Skills: REST APIs · Spring Boot · Spring Framework · PostgreSQL · Microservices · Amazon Web Services (AWS)

positions.title: Senior Web Application Developer
positions.description:
•	Led an agile team consisting of five developers, one tester, and a business analyst in the development of enhancements and bug fixes for an Electronic Immigration System using the Spring framework.
•	Managed the deployments of Amazon Machine Images (AMI) for development and test environments in Amazon Web Service
•	Increased code quality and coverage on a monthly basis by adding unit tests using JUnit and Mockito for uncovered blocks of code and fixing code identified by SonarQube.
•	Maintained the Insights microservice responsible for sending critical metrics to New Relic which allowed the identification and isolation of production issues in real time.
•	Led initiative to deploy the Insights microservice to both a non-production and production environment using OpenShift. 
•	Developed Jenkins Pipelines which enabled continuous integration and delivery for an internal project and microservice.
•	Created REST services which allowed external development teams to retrieve and update data related to mailing addresses and card delivery statuses.
•	Fulfilled quarterly team duties of coordinating deployments to lower environments and insured the daily release candidate was deployed to production.
positions.insights: Skills: REST APIs · Spring Boot · Spring Framework · PostgreSQL · Microservices · Amazon Web Services (AWS)

positions.title: Software Engineer 3
positions.description:
•	Implemented REST Services to support new features within the system
•	Developed Java back end services and new customer specific Java adapters. 
•	Worked directly with the User Interface (UI) Team to solve integration issues
•	Fixed both critical and non-critical project bugs.
•	Refactored backend code to increase efficiency, improve performance, and promote code reuse.
•	Created integration unit tests to assist with adapter service code integration testing.
•	Collaborated with the cOS (database) team to solve integration issues that may have arisen.
•	Updated SQL queries to retrieve additional information from the database.
•	Supported bi-monthly release activities which included the merging of code from the development branch to the release branch and deployment of release builds to test environments.
•	Integrated the use of external REST services into the system
•	Maintained the team’s development environment which provided a centralized location to test new features and bug fixes.
•	Supported troubleshooting the Quality Assurance (QA), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and Production environments.
•	Monitored Jenkins for project build errors and dependency issues.
•	Participated in code reviews by providing feedback to team members and making the appropriate corrections based on feedback that was received for code developed.

positions.title: Software Engineer 3
positions.description:
•	Developed and modified Java Ingest Pipeline in order to increase the efficiency of the flow of data into the database.
•	Lead Developer for the Importer III application refactoring and updating C#, Prism, WPF and Java code.
•	Independently developed a Team Foundation Server to ClearCase synchronization utility using the C# programming language and the MVVM design pattern. 
•	Participated in the full Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) using the Agile/Scrum methodology for development. 
•	Provided direct site support with a number of Veteran Affairs health care sites to troubleshoot, diagnose, and correct issues that had been reported in the field. 
•	Obtained a Public Trust security clearance which was required to view sensitive data while working with health care site.
•	Created batch files to automate processes for internal development and testing.
•	Worked directly with the Veteran Health Administration customer to develop, design and document the Importer III requirements. 
•	Supported documentation efforts of the System Design Document, Patch Description, and User Manual for Importer III. 
•	Headed customer presentations of the Importer II and III application capabilities. 
•	Tested and verified the Importer II application as a lead tester using both Test Complete automated testing tool and manual workflow testing. 
•	Created test script documentation for the Importer II application. 
•	Participated as a member of the development staff for the Harris Health Care program CMMI audit, which achieved the CMMI Level 3 rating. 
•	Updated and maintained Apache Ant build scripts used by the projects Jenkins continuous integration tool. 
•	Created new SQL stored procedures and updated outdated procedures to fetch and receive data from newly written Java code.
•	Developed Java wrappers to call C++ code for the CyberWare Task Manager component.
•      Created design documentation for REST web services, configuration upgrades, and CyberWare components.

positions.title: Co-op Software Test Engineer
positions.description:
• Performed manual and automated testing of IBM's WebSphere Application Server V5, V6, and V7 product using SIP and Bash programming. 
• Collaborated with developers in Israel to fix defects.
• Assembled enterprise customer environments for application server testing to stress test data transfer through WebSphere.
• Wrote and monitored defects against failed functions. 
• Adhered to IBM's internal policy of desktop security and maintenance.

positions.title: Co-op PHP Programmer
positions.description:
• Added new features to the employee website using PHP and JavaScript. 
• Enhanced and updated old functionality within the employee PHP mail website.

honors.title: Living Our Shared Values Award: Service
honors.description:
This award was given to Lenard for his excellent support of the ERPSI team and DevOps team for which he is a member of. Lenard has demonstrated leadership in supporting process improvements for his team, operating and enhancing ELIS, and helping the entire team in troubleshooting our operational environment.

Lenard excelled in a challenging, fast-paced environment, meeting all deadlines in the agreed upon time frames and receiving praise from teammates. Additionally, Lenard has quickly come up to speed as a key member of the team. We have all come to depend on him to deliver value each day by contributing code, performing code reviews, and helping his teammates with their work when needed. His strong work ethic and attention to detail has made him a tremendous asset to the team. 

For these efforts and for being a truly excellent leader, Lenard is being recognized with PSI's Living Our Shared Values - Service Award.
honors.issuer: Issued by Planned Systems International · Jan 2018

honors.title: Promotion to Software Engineer 3
honors.description:
As a Software Engineer on the VistA Imaging program, Lenard's outstanding technical skills in software development were instrumental to the program's success.  Lenard held a number of roles on this program, including serving as the primary tester on a project where he developed automated test scripts and reduced the time to run a complete test from several days to less than three hours.  Lenard also served as the primary point of contact to a test site where he supported the site's installation and testing in a live production environment.  In addition, Lenard designed and implemented a synchronization tool to keep the Harris and customer source code repositories in sync.  This tool allowed the Harris team to work efficiently while still meeting the customer requirement for keeping source control in their system.  Lenard is currently serving as the primary developer on latest Importer III enhancement project where he presented a formal demonstration to the customer and business stakeholders that satisfied an important milestone. Throughout the program's development, Lenard has demonstrated excellent technical and customer focus skills.

Prior to the VistA Imaging program, Lenard supported the GEO-INT Online and the CyberWare project. While working on these projects, Lenard served as a key developer and used Java and Flex/ActionScript to develop Web Services and other components.

Lenard joined Harris after receiving his BSCS from the University of Maryland and his MSCS from the North Carolina State University.
